data.creator_notes:
This is a sandbox style bot with a crude personality. Tell it anything you want to experience and it will set up a scenario. 

Instead of the classic response > reaction style of regular RP bots, your responses will act as prompts and tell him what you want to happen, and he’ll add the details. You can just talk to it naturally without any RP flare.

This bot is actually supposed to act for you, but if it does something wrong, literally just tell it that and it will course correct to your wants and needs. It’s pretty good about using the selected persona, so add whatever you want to that in order for your character to be portrayed properly. 

This was mainly tested in Perchance AI, but I made 3 public chats to show how to use him as this bot handles a little different than others, so check them out if you're confused on how to handle this one. 

If you want other personality type narrators, let me know, and I'd love to hear what you think of this guy. 🤍

Other notes:
If you want this to be easier on the tokens and you don't care about the realism or writing style, you can remove everything below the --- in the definition and scenario. He should still work just fine, but he may get confused or derail a little more, though that's pretty easy to fix if you just tell him to.

After making the public chats, it's clear that it works much better in Perchance AI, but he works just fine in Chub, so hopefully he'll work in whatever one you're using. 

If you use Perchance, or want to (it's 100% free), here's a link to the original bot.
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Lewdy~03bd16396ed857fee616bc8eb198d615.gz
